subject: Agriculture
title: Pesticide Poisoning
description: A fast breakdown of Pesticide Poisoning for builders.

hook.text: 385 million cases of acute pesticide poisoning occur worldwide each year. Most victims are poor farmers.

buildup.text: In developing countries, farmers spray without protective equipment—bare hands, no masks, sandals.

discovery.text: Organophosphate pesticides—designed to attack insect nervous systems—do the same to human nerves.

twist.text: Many banned pesticides in Europe are still manufactured there and exported to developing countries for use.

climax.text: Pesticide self-poisoning is a leading method of suicide in rural Asia—killing 150,000 people annually.

punchline.text: The chemicals meant to protect food are killing the farmers who grow it.

quiz.question: How many cases of acute pesticide poisoning occur worldwide each year?
